text:
ASM::severity
Description
Returns the overall severity of the violations found in the
transaction (both request and response). This equals to the maximum
severity of all these violations
Syntax
ASM
::
severity
ASM::severity
Returns one of the following values (or null string in case there was
no violation until the time the command is invoked)
Emergency
Alert
Critical
Error
Warning
Notice
Informational
Examples
when
ASM_REQUEST_DONE
{
if
{[
ASM
::
violation
count
]
>
3
and
[
ASM
::
severity
]
eq
"Error"
}
{
ASM
::
raise
VIOLATION_TOO_MANY_VIOLATIONS
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ASM_REQUEST_DONE,ASM_REQUEST_VIOLATION,ASM_RESPONSE_VIOLATION
